;0x0000132e;((self.$R=self.$R||{})["server-fn:0"]=[],($R=>$R[0]={question:$R[1]={id:2067194810,program:102,test:2,skill:2,difficulty:2,isLive:!1,multiChoice:!0,updateDate:$R[2]=new Date("2023-08-02T20:25:59.637Z"),createDate:$R[3]=new Date("2023-08-02T20:25:59.637Z"),externalId:null,ibn:"09335-DC",stem:"\x3Cdiv> \x3Cdiv> \x3Cdiv> \x3Cp>According to data provided by the US Department of Energy, the average price per gallon of regular gasoline in the United&nbsp;States from September 1, 2014, to December 1, 2014, is modeled by the function \x3Cspan>F\x3C/span> defined below, where \x3Cspan>\x3Cspan>\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt=\"F of x \">\x3C/span>\x3C/span> is the average price per gallon \x3Cspan>x\x3C/span>&nbsp;months after September 1.\x3C/p> \x3C/div> \x3C/div> \x3Cp>\x3Cspan>\x3Cspan>\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt>\x3C/span>\x3C/span>\x3C/p> \x3C/div>\x3Cp>The constant 2.74 in this function estimates which of the following?\x3C/p>",rationale:"\x3Cp>Choice D is correct. Since 2.74 is a constant term, it represents an actual price of gas rather than a measure of change in gas price. To determine what gas price it represents, find&nbsp;\x3Cspan>x\x3C/span>&nbsp;such that&nbsp;\x3Cspan>F\x3C/span>(\x3Cspan>x\x3C/span>) = 2.74, or 2.74 = 2.74 &ndash; 0.19(\x3Cspan>x\x3C/span>&nbsp;&ndash; 3). Subtracting 2.74 from both sides gives 0 = &ndash;0.19(\x3Cspan>x\x3C/span>&nbsp;&ndash; 3). Dividing both sides by &ndash;0.19 results in 0 =&nbsp;\x3Cspan>x\x3C/span>&nbsp;&ndash; 3, or&nbsp;\x3Cspan>x\x3C/span>&nbsp;= 3. Therefore, the average price of gas is $2.74 per gallon 3 months after September 1, 2014, which is December 1, 2014.\x3C/p>\x3Cp>Choice A is incorrect. Since 2.74 is a constant, not a multiple of \x3Cspan>x\x3C/span>, it cannot represent a rate of change in price. Choice B is incorrect. The difference in the average price from September 1, 2014, to December 1, 2014, is&nbsp;\x3Cspan>F\x3C/span>(3) &ndash;&nbsp;\x3Cspan>F\x3C/span>(0) = 2.74 &ndash; 0.19(3 &ndash; 3) &ndash; (2.74 &ndash; 0.19(0 &ndash; 3)) = 2.74 &ndash; (2.74 + 0.57) = &ndash;0.57, which is not 2.74. Choice C is incorrect. The average price per gallon on September 1, 2014, is&nbsp;\x3Cspan>F\x3C/span>(0) = 2.74 &ndash; 0.19(0 &ndash; 3) = 2.74 + 0.57 = 3.31, which is not 2.74.\x3C/p>\x3Cp>\x3C/p>"},answers:$R[4]=[$R[5]={id:15629,question:2067194810,correct:!1,content:"\x3Cp>The average monthly decrease in the price per gallon\x3C/p>\n"},$R[6]={id:15630,question:2067194810,correct:!1,content:"\x3Cp>The difference in the average price per gallon from September&nbsp;1,&nbsp;2014, to December&nbsp;1,&nbsp;2014\x3C/p>\n"},$R[7]={id:15631,question:2067194810,correct:!1,content:"\x3Cp>The average price per gallon on September 1, 2014\x3C/p>\n"},$R[8]={id:15632,question:2067194810,correct:!0,content:"\x3Cp>The average price per gallon on December 1, 2014\x3C/p>\n"}],userData:void 0})($R["server-fn:0"]))
